The service crew discussed a thought on tag checks, and thank you for your feedback. We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal during travel and the distress caused by the service lapse. The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes such reports seriously, because calm and humane handling is the standard expected from every member of the operation.

We have reviewed the handling notes, the transfer point, and the communication trail linked to the journey. The issue appears to have arisen during a routine transition between service teams, and that is not consistent with the level of care Aurelia Skyways intends to provide. Please be assured that the senior coordinator has been informed and that the matter is being addressed through our internal review process. Our aim is to restore confidence, correct any process weakness, and prevent a repeat of the same concern.

<<FACT F119>> We are prepared to support any further review that may be required and will cooperate fully with the appropriate claims process. If your companion animal shows any continuing signs of stress or discomfort, we recommend that you seek prompt professional attention and keep the relevant supporting records together for submission.

We also want to address the wider concern about animal welfare during transport. Our handlers are instructed to use measured, low-stress methods and to avoid any action that could unsettle the animal unnecessarily. Where a transfer issue is identified, the desk expects prompt reporting, respectful communication, and careful follow-through until the case is resolved. This approach applies across the service path, from acceptance to handover.

<<FACT F114>> If your case involves an escape in transit, we will examine the record carefully and provide guidance on the next steps available to you. We appreciate the seriousness of the matter and the trust placed in Aurelia Skyways when you travel with a companion animal.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We regret the inconvenience and remain committed to careful, responsible service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
